model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the inference time measured for the baseline Llama-1B models as well as our distilled Llama (pure Mamba) and MambaLlama (hybrid models at the 1B and 3B scale. The x-axis represents the batch size, ranging from 1 to 512, and the y-axis represents the inference time in seconds, ranging from 0 to 10. The line plot shows that as the batch size increases, the inference time also increases for all models. The distilled Llama models, both pure Mamba and MambaLlama, show a significant reduction in inference time compared to the baseline Llama-1B model across all batch sizes. The distilled Llama-3B model, in particular, demonstrates the most substantial decrease in inference time, indicating a higher speedup for this model. The plot also includes representative values at the start and end of the x-axis, with peaks and declines in inference time at various batch sizes.
